title: Botamus Prime AI Messenger
summary: Botamus prime is my experiment in working to discover new ways to leverage AI in software engineering. Botamus Prime is a real-time messaging platform that connects users to their AI agents over low-latency WebSocket channels. The idea being you can use this messaging app like a chat app on the go to work with your AI coding partner while you're away from your desk.
highlights: Real time messaging with AI agents
Plugin archetecture, allows you to easily integrate your own AI agentic app to the platform

title: Smart Home Management Hub
summary: This home management app is designed to remind a home owner of the routine maintenance tasks that are required to keep a home running in top shape. Scaled out it would be an app to keep track of all of your appliances and enable users to track maintenance who worked on their appliance last.
highlights: Easy to use interface for setting up new appliances and maintenance schedules
View all of your appliances and their maintenance history in one place
Notifications and reminders to stay on top of home maintenance
